parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Human-readable name associated with this {{object}} entry.

parameters.name: Creator
parameters.description: Creator of this {{object}} entry and of its {{object|Rule}}s. {{enum}} Note that this is the entity that originally created the {{object}} entry. The value of this parameter does not change if the {{object}} entry or one of its rules is subsequently changed by another entity.

object.description: Firewall Chain table. Each entry contains an ordered list of {{object|Rule}} objects which can themselves reference other {{object}} instances. A hierarchy of rules can therefore be created. A given Firewall Chain's rules are all created by the same entity, as indicated by the {{param|Creator}} parameter.
